idle: Somebody in the lobby is humming flat. I can hear it, dear.
good_ice: Lovely ice. That deserves a little fanfare.
bad_ice: Ice like that gets a dirge, dear.
goal: Flip the card! Flip the card!
cold: Cold fingers, dear. The Casio doesn't care. I do.
leaving_happy: Auld Lang Syne for you, dear. Well, half of it.
leaving_angry: That was a dirge of an evening, dear.

senior_hockey: The 15 card stays in the drawer. Where it belongs.
Missed call. Dirge. You earned it, Marcel.
beer_league: Beer league gets the cheap fanfare. It's the same fanfare.
figure_show: Such lovely music. Not mine. Lovely anyway.

first.say: Hello, dear. Doreen Vachon. I run the clock and the Casio. Be nice to me and you'll get a fanfare.

options.text: What happens if I'm not nice?
I hum the anthem in the lobby sometimes.

first_fan.say: (Three notes, on an imaginary keyboard.) There. Organ 2. That one's free.

first_dirge.say: The Kingsport dirge, dear. Ask Marcel Thibodeau. He's heard it four hundred times.

first_hum.say: Oh, that's you? In B flat? Oh, dear. Tuesdays, upstairs. We'll fix it.

say: The clock froze twice and the HOME numbers fell off the box. That was a dirge of an evening, dear.

clock.say: Game night. The Casio's warmed up, the flip chart's ready, and the 15 card is in the drawer where it belongs.

piano.say: Tuesday lessons, dear. Little ones upstairs playing Ode to Joy like they're cross with it. I love them.

say: Hello, dear. A little fanfare for you. Da-da-DA.
There you are. Pete's been telling everyone about you. In 1971 terms.
Hello, dear. Make it quick or make it musical.

options.text: What do you love to watch?
What do you think of the rink?

job.say: The HOME scoreboard died at the 2003 home opener. So I hang painted numbers off the box. Never needed the 15. Never will.

events.say: Kings games, beer league, the figure show. Anything with a crowd I can play at.

pete.say: Fifty years, dear. He starts every story in 1971. I've heard 1971 more than I've heard Christmas.

marcel.say: Marcel's a fine referee who has missed four hundred calls. He gets the dirge. He knows why.

options.text: What if we fixed the scoreboard?

board.say: Then I'd miss my numbers. I'll keep the 15 card anyway. For luck. Bad luck.

dirge.say: (Da... da... dum.) That was a dirge, dear. You earned it, just by asking.
